title: The Incoming Student's Guide to Strixhaven: A Young Planeswalker's Guide

paragraphs.text: The Incoming Student's Guide to Strixhaven: A Young Planeswalker's Guide is a young adult guide written by K. Arsenault Rivera that will be published by Ten Speed Press on April 27, 2027.

The Incoming Student’s Guide to Strixhaven is an in-world visual history of Strixhaven University , the greatest and most fantastical school of magic in the Magic: The Gathering Multiverse . Inside its pages, young readers will discover a brief history of Arcavios and the school; an overview of its five colleges; tips for first years; the dazzling deeds of the school’s most notable alumni; and, most importantly, how to get there and essential information on the Strixhaven job placement program.
Written by acclaimed fantasy novelist K. Arsenault Rivera, this companion to the Secrets of Strixhaven is sure to charm and enlighten readers and Magic: The Gathering fans of all ages.

Welcome to Strixhaven University! As seen through the eyes of its staff, including an introduction by Professor Liliana Vess , this book details the history of Arcavios, provides the inside scoop of the University’s five colleges, and shares tips and tricks for life on campus.
